cards.title: Prairie School house
cards.description: Prairie School houses use low roofs, broad eaves and bands of windows to emphasize the horizon. Rooms often connect more openly to one another and to the landscape.
look_for: Low hipped roof with broad eaves
cards.main_idea: Connect domestic space to the horizontal landscape.
cards.source_design: Original generated design; not a named historic Wright building

cards.title: Postmodern neighbourhood library
cards.description: Postmodern architecture combines familiar historical forms with modern materials, colour and playful changes of scale. Buildings may use oversized pediments, contrasting shapes or symbolic entrances to communicate with people and respond to their surroundings.
cards.main_idea: Make architecture expressive and readable through references and visual play.
cards.source_design: Original generated design; not a reconstruction of a named historic building
